subject: exp-dy
title: EXP.DY.-----POL.P.
description: Diagram closing MP(II)-32 — the section on world politics at the close of the seventies and how western political functionalism has expanded western culture's material/geographical reality while 'progressively crushing the life options of composite world culture.' The prose directly above identifies the structural object the diagram captures: 'the nature underlying how these various progressions have actualized is indeed related to the realness of politics, and this concerns the whole of humanity.' The crossing diagrams how expansion-dynamics meets political-policies: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is crossed with POL-P (political policies). EXP-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; INFO-DY (information dynamics) drops below the main line, with C-INFO (composite information) and EXT-FT (extended functionalism) branching from it. SOC-RT (social reality) rises above the main line, with PART (participation) branching from it and JR-DYM (journalism dynamics) from PART; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branches from the main line on the upper-right, with TRS (transition) branching from it and CULT-TF-S (cultural transfer shift) from TRS. POL-P sits centrally as partner-axis. Structural argument: the upper chain SOC-RT → PART → JR-DYM is the *world-information question* the prose names.
